sources.title: ihhelsinki.fi
highlights: If you are in Finland working and receiving pay, or if you are an entrepreneur, you will need a Finnish tax card
A valid passport or identity card
You usually get a tax card right away when you visit the Vero service desk, if you have a Finnish Personal Identity Code and required information about your income
You can call the Tax Administration’s telephone service at +358 29 497 010 (Mon–Fri, 9–16) to book an appointment to get a Finnish personal identity code and a tax card at the same time
The Tax Administration (Vero) serves customers on weekdays from 9:00 to 16:00

sources.title: vero.fi
highlights: To apply for the card and the number, you need a Finnish personal identity code

sources.title: suomi.fi
highlights: Take your residence permit with you if you are not a citizen of an EU Member State, Iceland, Liechtenstein, Norway, or Switzerland
Apply for a tax card using the MyTax online service Opens in a new window., from the tax office or by calling a service number
If the employer does not have your tax card, 60% of your salary will be withheld as an advance tax
